title: University Great Library
purpose: Universities sector card and scholarly-archive surfaces.
story: A great library of bound volumes in the late evening — centuries of knowledge held in shadow, a single lamp keeping vigil.
environment: A long galleried library, tiers of bookcases rising two storeys, a reading aisle running into darkness.
architecture: Baroque library interior — a vaulted ceiling, a wrought-iron gallery balcony, carved bookcase pediments above the stacks.
composition: Bookcases receding symmetrically down the aisle, a lone reading lamp anchoring the foreground, the gallery lost in negative space above.
continuityNotes: Matches the set's near-black grade, single warm source, and brass-on-black palette of scene-01; no legible titles on any spine.
